# RevenueCapture.ai

> A 4-Pillar AI Lead Audit tool that helps service businesses identify revenue leaks across Voice AI, Conversational AI, Reputation Management, and Database Reactivation.

RevenueCapture.ai is an internal audit dashboard used by consultants to score a prospect's lead-capture process and generate a branded PDF report with revenue-gap calculations.

- [Home](/): AI Lead Audit dashboard overview.
